criteria.rationale: The recent note documents walking most evenings and a plan to continue diet and walking with Wegovy. It describes cutting back on fast food but does not establish that the diet is reduced-calorie.

The notes document diet and walking efforts in May and August, but neither establishes participation in a comprehensive program with continuing follow-up for a continuous six months. The phrase “past several months” cannot establish the required duration.

missing_requirements: Documentation that Wegovy will be used with a reduced-calorie diet as well as increased physical activity.
Dated evidence of at least six continuous months of participation in a comprehensive weight-management program with the required components and continuing follow-up.
parsed.summary: Walking and dietary changes are documented, but a reduced-calorie diet is not established. The records also do not establish six continuous months in a comprehensive weight-management program. The evaluated criteria are not ready for approval.
